invariants: Every milestone has exactly one existing parent session.
A session lists exactly its child milestone identities.
A lane is a responsibility-bearing node and is never a session or milestone.
A session cannot be terminal while a required milestone is not satisfied or a required lane is not validated.
Every advanced v2 session declares a non-empty completion_rule_id.
A completion_rule_id is unique to one session; sequential checkpoints sharing that identity remain milestones of that session.
Equivalent normalized completion_rule text cannot be split across sessions by assigning different identities.
Session inventory, parent identity, revision, and canonical session digest exactly match the configured evidence_authority_root_v2.
Trusted-root path and expected digest are supplied out of band and cannot be selected by the work-breakdown payload.
name_policy: Names may trigger warnings but never determine work-unit kind or validity.
